page.overview:
What is Chiseled Bookshelf?

Chiseled bookshelves are blocks that can hold books, books and quills, written books, enchanted books and knowledge books.

Chiseled bookshelves can be destroyed with any tool, but an axe mines it the fastest. When broken, all contained books are dropped as items. The block itself drops only when broken using a tool enchanted with Silk Touch.

Chiseled bookshelves can hold up to six books, books and quills, written books, enchanted books, and/or knowledge books. There is no GUI; books are instead added into the bookshelf by on a slot with a book. Doing so will place a book in that slot. on an occupied slot will remove the book from that slot.

Chiseled bookshelves do not increase the power of enchanting tables.
